text:
If you're planning to burn off that morning fog with some sunshine, patience pays off today, the gray burns back to mostly sunny skies and a high near 82. There's a small morning shower chance before 8, and the American model keeps things mostly dry while the European model is notably wetter this afternoon, so I wouldn't be shocked by a passing shower or rumble later, but I'd bet on the drier side. Winds stay light out of the north, water's sitting at 71 and calm, waves a foot or less, so the lake will be glassy and easy most of the day.

Saturday warms further, a high near 85 with south winds building through the afternoon into evening, 10 to 15 knots on the broad lake and gusting higher overnight, so if you're out on the water Saturday, plan your paddle or sail for morning through early afternoon before that breeze stacks up. Sunday's rain chances have actually backed off overnight, now looking mostly dry, with the real wet stretch holding off until late Sunday into Monday. Good beach and boat window today through Saturday early afternoon; after that, respect the building south wind.
